edits.old: Tokens are uncached input plus cache writes plus output
edits.new: Tokens are uncached input plus cache writes plus output. The session's meter is the clock: it records the UTC time when each mode starts and compares the time elapsed with the estimate at every step boundary. It records tokens only from a figure it can read without opening a file that holds a prompt body, and otherwise records them as not measured

edits.old: A write that returned success is not a verified write.
edits.new: A write that returned success is not a verified write, and a Notion write can still be landing when its call returns: ask the tool to finish before it returns, poll any pending task it returns until it reports success, and only then read the page back. A task that reports failure is a tool error: fetch the page before anything else.
edits.check: can still be landing when its call returns

edits.new: the next read goes back to Notion. So does a read lost to a context compaction: fetch the body live again before any step relies on it, and never recover it from a transcript.

edits.old: A capture opens only the transcript of the worker whose return it takes.
edits.new: A capture opens only the transcript of the worker whose return it takes. A script over a save prints only what the check needs, such as an edit time, one section of a control page, or a count. A count over a body fetched inline is made by reading and checked by a second reading, and the record says how each count was made.
edits.check: A script over a save prints only what the check needs

edits.old: never a source for later work, and left to the harness's teardown.
edits.new: never a source for later work. A save is deleted once its check is done; a file the harness keeps, such as a transcript, or a save it will not let the session delete, is left to its teardown (`D22` condition 4).
edits.check: A save is deleted once its check is done
edits.absent: and left to the harness's teardown.
